prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1265; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked across the center and the trunk lid shows a crease along its lower edge, consistent with the reported rear-end impact. The tail lamp assembly on the driver side is broken, and the rear quarter panel has a shallow buckle near the bumper mount. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known, and the photos show no signs of prior repair. The labor hours listed fit the scope of this damage. Two similar charges posted on the same day are being verified with the shop before the estimate is finalized. Repair plan: replace the bumper cover, tail lamp, and trunk lid, and repair the quarter panel.
